data: ALTER TABLE notificationmodel ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS run_id UUID NULL

DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_notificationmodel_run') THEN ALTER TABLE notificationmodel ADD CONSTRAINT fk_notificationmodel_run FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES test_run(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; END IF; END $$
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_notification_run_event_user ON notificationmodel (run_id, event, user_id) WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_notification_run_id ON notificationmodel (run_id) WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL
